Heap-buffer-overflow in BFD when processing a crafted XCOFF object file during linking. Triggered only by the linker consuming attacker-supplied XCOFF input. No upstream binutils fix has shipped yet.

readelf denial-of-service when processing a crafted ELF file; can lead to excessive resource consumption or program crash. Impact limited to local denial of service. No upstream binutils fix has shipped yet.

Two readelf denial-of-service issues (resource exhaustion / OOM and NULL pointer dereference / segfault) triggered by processing a crafted ELF file. Impact is limited to local denial of service when invoking readelf on attacker-supplied input. No upstream binutils fix has shipped yet.
